critical_rejection_factor: GS1 EPCIS global supply chain standards operate over standard enterprise messaging protocols without token friction.

critical_rejection_factor: Contractual penalty clauses are subject to judicial moderation (Civil Code Art. 1154); automated, unstoppable penalty execution is legally void.

critical_rejection_factor: Regulated insurers require audited reserve pools under Solvency II; weather and disaster oracles remain centralized points of failure.

critical_rejection_factor: Industrial consortia operate under formal shareholder pacts and notarized bylaws; token staking carries no corporate legal validity.

denomination: Multi-Tenant IAM Protocol with On-Chain Credentials
dominant_incumbent: Microsoft Entra ID / Okta Workforce Identity
critical_rejection_factor: OIDC and SAML 2.0 dominate enterprise identity federation; on-chain credentials lack integration with enterprise perimeter firewalls.

dominant_incumbent: Stripe Connect Custom / ERP Split Billing
critical_rejection_factor: B2B revenue splitting requires statutory tax withholdings and bilateral invoicing, which flat cryptographic transfers cannot accommodate.

dominant_incumbent: SEPA Instant / Wise Business / Revolut Business

denomination: Delivery-Triggered Payment-as-a-Service Protocol
critical_rejection_factor: Freight delivery confirmation relies on signed e-CMR waybills; electronic logistics APIs already automate settlement upon digital signature.

dominant_incumbent: REE / OMIE National Electricity Clearing House

dominant_incumbent: SWIFT MT700 Messaging / Standard Trade Bank Facilities
critical_rejection_factor: Bank letters of credit operate under ICC UCP 600 rules; commercial banks reject smart contract execution risks without standardized legal recourse.

critical_rejection_factor: M&A EBITDA earnout milestones are contentious accounting calculations; private equity funds will not lock capital into blind on-chain escrows.

dominant_incumbent: Certified Royalty Audits / SAP Billing and Revenue
critical_rejection_factor: IP royalties depend on certified external commercial sales audits; accounting reconciliations prevent instant programmatic settlement.

critical_rejection_factor: Labor laws require wage payments in legal tender; paying payroll in crypto assets transfers currency risk and triggers labor inspection sanctions.

dominant_incumbent: EU ETS Sovereign Registry / Verra Registry
critical_rejection_factor: Official carbon credit registries (EU ETS) are sovereign government monopolies; parallel tokenized credits lack legal accounting compliance.

critical_rejection_factor: ERC-4337 account abstraction introduces operational complexity and bundler fees compared to traditional API keys and OAuth servers.

critical_rejection_factor: The financial opportunity cost of immobilizing collateral on-chain exceeds the cost of standard corporate SLAs with deferred penalties.

critical_rejection_factor: Commercial data aggregators enforce closed licensing; web scrapers ignore on-chain micropayments and extract public datasets directly.
